combatController.noToken: Combat Controller: select one of your tokens, or let the gamemaster assign you a character that has a token on this scene.

bindings.name: Sticks and buttons
bindings.label: Configure gamepad
bindings.hint: Which stick and button of your gamepad is used for what. The defaults fit a standard gamepad.

hints.name: Button hints
hints.hint: A bar at the top of the screen shows what the buttons do while the gamepad controls the combat hud, a menu or a dialog.

turn_rumble.name: Rumble on your turn
turn_rumble.hint: The gamepad rumbles when the turn of your token starts.

turn_open.name: Combat hud on your turn
turn_open.hint: Opens the hud of Argon for the gamepad when the turn of your token starts, and leaves it when the turn ends.

token_speed.name: Token speed
token_speed.hint: How fast your token walks while the stick is held, in grid spaces per second. Foundry itself moves tokens with 6.

free_walk.name: Walk freely
free_walk.hint: The left stick walks your token freely, like the right stick pans the map: not bound to the grid, and slower when pushed a little. Turn this off to walk from grid space to grid space instead.

bindingsApp.title: Combat Controller: sticks and buttons
bindingsApp.info: Click detect and use the stick or button on your gamepad, or type in its number. Nothing in the game reacts to the gamepad while a detection is running.
bindingsApp.pressButton: Press the button on the gamepad that you want to use.
bindingsApp.pushRight: Push the stick that you want to use to the right.
bindingsApp.pushDown: Pull the stick that you want to use towards you.
bindingsApp.timeout: Combat Controller: nothing detected. Press a button on the gamepad first so the browser sees it.

bindings.move-horizontal: Left stick, left / right: walk, focus
bindings.move-vertical: Left stick, up / down: walk, focus
bindings.pan-horizontal: Right stick, left / right: pan the map
bindings.pan-vertical: Right stick, up / down: pan the map
bindings.loadout: Next weapon set / zoom out / turn area
bindings.jump: Hold + d-pad: jump, undo step. Hold + stick: precise movement / zoom in / turn area
bindings.disadvantage: Hold while using: ctrl-click, disadvantage / flip token
bindings.advantage: Hold while using: alt-click, advantage / door
bindings.toggle: Open and hide the combat hud
bindings.center: Center the map on your token

hud.jump: + ←→ jump, ↓ undo, ↑ redo, + stick precise move
